researchMethod: Live WebSearch/WebFetch/curl against Hugging Face dataset API, dataset READMEs, and source GitHub repos on 2026-07-03. No values taken from model memory; every URL below was resolved live and license text read from the source.
phiPolicy: Datasets containing raw PHI are FORBIDDEN. All pinned datasets are exam-derived or machine-translated exam QA with only synthetic/hypothetical patient vignettes (no real patient records). Verified by inspecting sample rows.

researchCandidates.name: JMedBench (Coldog2333/JMedBench)
researchCandidates.note: Benchmark collection of 20 datasets / 5 tasks for Japanese biomedical LLMs (Aizawa Lab, U-Tokyo/NII; arXiv:2409.13317). Per-subset licenses vary; we pin only license-clean, no-PHI subsets. 1.38 GB total; JSONL per subset with train/validation/test splits.

researchCandidates.name: JMMLU medical subsets (via JMedBench jmmlu_medical + upstream nlp-waseda/JMMLU)
researchCandidates.note: Native Japanese MMLU. Medical subjects (professional_medicine, medical_genetics, college_medicine, clinical_knowledge, anatomy, virology, etc.) are under CC-BY-SA-4.0. Commercial use for LM research/evaluation is explicitly permitted upstream. No PHI (academic exam MCQA).

researchCandidates.name: IgakuQA (jungokasai/IgakuQA)
researchCandidates.note: Japanese Medical Licensing Examination QA (2018-2022, MHLW source; arXiv:2303.18027). GitHub repo has NO LICENSE file (API license: null) and JMedBench marks its license as '-' (unresolved). Because local-research redistribution terms cannot be confirmed live, it is NOT pinned. JMMLU-medical (CC-BY-SA-4.0) is used as the license-clean native-JA medical eval instead.

researchCandidates.name: medqa_jp (JMedBench, translated MedQA)
researchCandidates.note: Japanese machine-translation (gpt-4-0613) of MedQA (jind11/MedQA), MIT-licensed. USMLE-style clinical-vignette QA with 5 options + gold answer. Hypothetical patients only (no real PHI). 10,178 train QA pairs usable as instruction/QA SFT corpus.

researchCandidates.name: ApolloCorpus (FreedomIntelligence/ApolloCorpus)
researchCandidates.note: Multilingual medical corpus covers English/Chinese/French/Spanish/Arabic/Hindi - no Japanese portion. Not suitable for a Japanese-capable copilot; superseded by medqa_jp for the SFT slot.

datasets.title: JMMLU medical subsets (Japanese medical MCQA)
datasets.license_verified_live: JMedBench README license table lists jmmlu_medical as CC-BY-SA-4.0; upstream nlp-waseda/JMMLU confirms medical subjects are in the CC-BY-SA-4.0 JMMLU folder (the 3 CC-BY-NC-ND subjects are all non-medical: idioms/civics/geography).
datasets.license_caveats: CC-BY-SA-4.0: attribution required and derivative datasets must be shared alike. Commercial use permitted. Local research use: permitted.
datasets.format: JSONL (fields: sample_id, question, options[], answer_idx, n_options, metadata)
datasets.anonymization: exam-derived / no PHI (academic multiple-choice medical exam questions; no patient records)
datasets.citation: Jiang, Huang, Aizawa. JMedBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Japanese Biomedical Large Language Models. arXiv:2409.13317 (2024). JMMLU: nlp-waseda/JMMLU (CC-BY-SA-4.0).

datasets.title: MedQA (Japanese) clinical-vignette QA for instruction tuning
datasets.license_verified_live: JMedBench README license table lists medqa_jp (and its English source MedQA) as MIT. Translation performed with gpt-4-0613.
datasets.license_caveats: MIT: permissive - commercial use, modification, redistribution all permitted with copyright/permission notice retained. Note: rows are machine-translated (gpt-4-0613); may contain translation errors - human review advised before clinical deployment. OpenAI-translated text may carry usage-policy considerations for the translated content.
datasets.format: JSONL (fields: sample_id, question, options[], answer_idx, n_options, metadata)
datasets.anonymization: exam-derived / synthetic - no PHI (USMLE-style hypothetical patient vignettes; no real patient data)
